description:
Logs a touchpoint with one of the user's job-search contacts — a call, a LinkedIn message, a coffee chat, a referral conversation, etc. The entry appears in the contact's interaction timeline in GigHQ.

**type is required.** Infer the best-fit type from what happened:
  • text_message — SMS/text
  • email_external — email
  • call — phone or video call
  • linkedin_connection_request — sent or accepted a connection request
  • linkedin_message — direct message on LinkedIn
  • coffee_chat — informational interview or coffee chat
  • in_person_meeting — face-to-face meeting
  • networking_event — conference, meetup, career fair
  • referral — the contact referred the user or made an introduction
  • other — anything else

Find the contact's UUID with `search_contacts`.

body.description: Short note about the interaction — what was discussed or sent. Max 3000 characters.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 date the interaction happened, e.g. '2026-07-10'. Defaults to now.

name: add_contact_interaction
